HAYKALAH structures transactions, and CMA-authorised institutions carry out the regulated activities within them.

Last updated 17 October 2026. We review this notice regularly and may update it.

On this page

  1. 01What HAYKALAH does
  2. 02What HAYKALAH does not do
  3. 03How regulated steps are handled
  4. 04Shariah approval
  5. 05Not investment advice
  6. 06Legal entity
  7. 07Questions

HAYKALAH is a Saudi advisory and structuring house registered under Commercial Registration No. 7014123751. HAYKALAH is not an Authorised Person of the Capital Market Authority. Where a transaction involves securities business regulated by the CMA, such as arranging, dealing, managing or advising on securities, or establishing or managing an investment fund, that activity is carried out by a CMA-authorised institution engaged for the transaction. Nothing on this website is an offer, a solicitation or investment advice.

Regulated activities are executed through appropriately licensed partners.

01What HAYKALAH does

  • Designs structures: Sukuk, funds, joint ventures, securitizations, bank facilities, holding companies and waqfs.
  • Prepares the models and documents behind them, from market research and feasibility to the information memorandum, term sheet and due diligence.
  • Runs bank processes from the borrower side and compares offers on one basis.
  • Coordinates the legal, Shariah, tax-and-Zakat and accounting advisers to one plan.
  • Co-founds ventures as an institutional co-founder, with part of its reward in equity that vests at agreed gates.

02What HAYKALAH does not do

  • HAYKALAH is not an Authorised Person of the Capital Market Authority.
  • It does not arrange, deal in, manage or advise on securities.
  • It does not establish or manage investment funds.
  • It does not issue, offer or deal in securities or tokens, and it does not offer investments.
  • It does not maintain its own Shariah board.

03How regulated steps are handled

In each transaction, the regulated steps are identified at the start. A CMA-authorised institution is engaged for that transaction to carry them out, and HAYKALAH structures, models, documents and coordinates around it. The institution’s role, and the approvals it needs, are set out in the transaction documents.

Regulated activities are executed through appropriately licensed partners.

04Shariah approval

HAYKALAH designs Shariah-compliant structures, such as Sukuk, Ijara, Istisna’a, Musataha, Wakala and Waqf. HAYKALAH does not maintain its own Shariah board. Each structure is reviewed and approved by the Shariah board of the issuer, fund or financial institution involved; where a client has none, HAYKALAH can arrange an independent Shariah board for the transaction. No structure is final until that approval is given.

05Not investment advice

Information only. All figures are indicative and subject to audit confirmation; project values are the size of the client project as recorded, not capital raised by HAYKALAH. Nothing on this website is an offer, a solicitation or investment advice. No guarantee of financing, returns, approvals or outcomes. Shariah structures are subject to Shariah board approval. Regulated activities are executed through appropriately licensed partners.

Ask HAYKALAH, the Structure Finder and the asset readiness check are educational tools and carry the line “Not investment advice”. HOAM, HAYKALAH’s opportunity matrix, is a screening tool, not investment advice.

07Questions

Is HAYKALAH regulated by the Capital Market Authority?

HAYKALAH is not an Authorised Person of the CMA. Securities business and investment-fund activities in a transaction are carried out by a CMA-authorised institution engaged for that transaction.

Who carries out the regulated parts of a transaction?

A CMA-authorised institution engaged for that transaction. HAYKALAH structures, models, documents and coordinates.

Who approves a structure under Shariah?

The Shariah board of the issuer, fund or financial institution involved. Where a client has none, HAYKALAH can arrange an independent Shariah board for the transaction. No structure is final until that approval is given.

Can I invest through HAYKALAH?

No. HAYKALAH does not offer investments, and nothing on this website is an offer, a solicitation or investment advice.

How can I check that a message really comes from HAYKALAH?

HAYKALAH contacts people only through haykalah.com and from @haykalah.com email addresses. Our fraud-awareness page explains how to check and report a message.

Fraud awareness

Discuss a structure with us. An NDA can come first.
